decision_authority: Finite evidence adjudication within the active command-coverage survey; not release sign-off.
accepted_scope: DO-first body entry plus CONTINUE-triggered bottom condition with reached side-effecting failing helper; prior loop and initially-false condition evidence remains scoped as recorded.

source_refs.finding: DO is registered as ENDIF_Instruction; LOOP is registered as LOOP_Instruction.
CONTINUE finds the paired LOOP and evaluates its condition; reached expression errors occur while executing CONTINUE in Native.

limitations: Native natural exit and exit code unobserved.
Other loop forms, malformed nesting and unrelated errors not covered.
